description: This Java class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for handling contact form submissions, including validation annotations and Swagger documentation.

classes.name: ContactRequest
classes.description: A DTO representing user input from a contact form, with validation and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the contact requester.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address of the contact requester.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject of the contact message.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the contact requester.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the email of the contact requester.

methods.name: setSubject
methods.description: Sets the subject of the message.
